summary: Header for public sites with main links, actions (Sign in or UserMenu), and a real mobile menu in a drawer; full multi-column or compact footer for portals.
whenToUse: Public sites, landing pages, informational areas, and sign-in pages.
Compact footer in portals and back-office apps.
whenNotToUse: Portals with many sections: use AppShell with Sidebar.
Multi-level menus with panels: use NavigationMenu in the navigation slot of Header.

props.name: links
props.description: Main links: inline from 768 px, in the drawer below.

props.name: currentId
props.description: Link of the current page (aria-current="page" and a visual indicator that isn’t color-only).

props.name: onNavigate
props.description: Notifies that a link was activated; the href is still followed (browser or RouterProvider).

props.name: navigationLabel
props.description: Name of the <nav> landmark and title of the drawer.

props.name: drawerFooter
props.description: Content at the bottom of the mobile drawer (e.g. sign-in buttons).

props.name: isMenuOpen / defaultMenuOpen / onMenuOpenChange
props.description: Mobile drawer state, controlled or uncontrolled.

props.name: Footer: columns, brand, legal
props.description: Link columns, brand, and legal text.

props.name: Footer: legalLinks
props.description: Short links in the bottom row (privacy, cookies, accessibility statement).

props.name: Footer: social
props.description: Social or contact links in the bottom row.

props.name: Footer: variant
props.description: “compact” shows a single row (brand, legal links, text) without columns.

keyboard.action: Reaches links and actions in visual order.
Opens the drawer with the links (below 768 px).
Closes the drawer and returns focus to the menu button.

accessibility: Named banner and navigation landmarks; the footer is contentinfo when not nested in article/section.
The menu button exposes aria-expanded and aria-controls; the drawer is modal and traps focus.
The current item uses aria-current="page" and an underline, not just color; in forced-colors mode it uses system colors.
Links are real <a href> elements that can be opened in a new tab.
responsive: Mobile-first: below 768 px the links are in the drawer; from 768 px they are inline. The drawer closes if the viewport widens.
Footer: columns reflow into a fluid grid; the bottom row wraps without overflow.
customization: Client-side routing: wrap the app in RouterProvider (react-aria-components) with your router’s navigate function.
To show different actions in the drawer, use drawerFooter.
commonMistakes: More than 5–6 main links: the bar wraps. Move secondary items to the footer.
Two <nav> landmarks with the same name on the same page: pass different navigationLabel values.

examples.name: PublicSiteHeader
examples.title: Public site header
examples.description: RouterProvider routes links to local state: the example shows the simulated path.

limits: Switching to the drawer uses a media query on the viewport, not the container width.
